description: Free tool for personalizing and enhancing Windows 11
##: The ZIP has a single win-x64 top folder; a duplicate publish/ build output is left in place.
Upstream misspells the asset as 'Protable' and changed its version token between v2.0.0 and v2.0.1, so checkver captures the full filename.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the asset has no API digest, so Scoop downloads the 96 MB ZIP to recompute it.
Case Converter.ini holds the user hotkey and is persisted across upgrades.
notes: Several tweaks change system settings and may require elevation.
